property_summary: For any caller (including contracts) that invokes c.owner(), the reference returns the stored owner (the deployer address set in constructor) regardless of msg.sender/tx.origin, whereas the mutant wrongly returns tx.origin and thus differs when a contract (where msg.sender != tx.origin) calls owner(); the test fuzzes an arbitrary caller address, deploys a small caller contract at that address and ensures the value returned by c.owner() when invoked through that contract equals the stored owner.
change_summary: Change owner() to return tx.origin instead of stored _owner, exposing the transaction origin as owner.
